day_06_morning: ^The Watch moves before dawn. By the time the Bell rings eight, every district gate is locked.
^Sera Vane stands on the checkpoint wall with a pike and a ledger of names.
^The Bellkeeper, she says. I have been ordered to bring you in. I am deciding whether to obey.
^Mara's hand is on her hammer. Wren is at the back of the room with Toma, both of them very still.
^The Iron Choir is already inside the walls, Sera says. If we fight each other, it takes the city.
^She is not lying. That is the worst part.
^Toma closes his notebook. Wren looks at you and does not blink.
watch: ^Sera lowers the pike. One hour, she says. Then you answer for the Bell.
^The gate opens. Watch soldiers fall in behind you. None of them look happy about it.
^Wren does not follow. Toma does, because Toma always follows the paper.
rebels: ^Then we take the gate, Wren says. Toma, the east lock. Mara, with me.
^Sera watches you go. I will not ask twice, she says.
alone: ^No, you say. Not the Watch. Not the rebels. Us.
^Mara nods once. Iven checks his bow. Wren's face closes like a door.
^Then you are already alone, Sera says.
afternoon_watch: ^The Iron Choir comes through the east gate singing. The Watch line breaks in three places.
^Sera holds the center. Hold the gate, she says. I will hold the song.
^The Choir has no faces. It has the city's old marching songs, sung backward.
afternoon_rebels: ^Sera Vane finds you at the east barricade. She has brought the Watch's best, and she has brought herself.
^I gave you a choice, she says. You chose the wrong side of the gate.
^The Bell is not a side, you say. It is a debt.
afternoon_refused: ^The Iron Choir corners you in the empty market. No Watch. No rebels. Just the party and the song.
^You wanted to stand alone, Mara says. Here we are.
^Iven nocks a bolt. Try to keep up, Bellkeeper.
day_06_night: ^After the battle, one of them does not answer.
^The Quiet has been in the city all day. It has learned how to wear a friend.
^Mara is standing at the window, but her reflection is a half-second late.
^Iven is checking his arbalest, but he has checked the same bolt nine times.
^Toma is writing, but the page is blank.
^You can reach one of them before the Bell rings.
mara: ^You take Mara's hand. The reflection catches up. She exhales like she has been holding the whole city.
^You are late, she says. You were late the last time too.
^The Quiet withdraws from the room. Not far.
iven: ^You put your hand over Iven's. He stops checking the bolt.
^That was not me, he says. I was here. I was here the whole time.
toma: ^You take the pen from Toma's hand. The blank page fills with one word, then another.
^Toma looks at it for a long time. Then he writes the date.
^The Quiet leaves him alone after that.
